title: A design exploration spreads its mockups across blind, informed and directed lanes
why: Your view, Oct 27: "a lot of design work sometimes prefers a lane or two of totally blank and a lane that gets to see the old and then some in between with directed prompts ... to get a good mix of control and idea between the mockups."
note: Merged to main on PR #661 (designer lanes), Oct 27. New skill design-explore: the orchestrator runs two blind lanes, one informed and two directed per explored screen; each mockup is named and labelled by lane kind; the owner culls, and the kept pair becomes <screen>.html for the builder and design reviewer. The mix is a default a brief may change; a small change gets one informed designer. Blindness rests on the brief: nothing blocks a read. The designer's start-up brief line names the lane kinds (test red then green). Two Sonnet review rounds, no blockers left. Port: yes; the agent and skill install everywhere.
